messages.content: Predict a human participant’s donation choice. The participant is a student at the University of Bonn and anonymously divides a separate €2 endowment between themself and each of four recipients. All four amounts are entered on the same page. Each amount independently ranges from 0 through 200 euro cents, in steps of 1 cent. There is no shared €2 budget across the four answers. Only one of the four decisions is randomly selected for payment. The amount given in that decision reaches that recipient anonymously as a small Christmas present in the following days; the participant receives 200 minus that amount in cents as cash at the end of the study, in addition to the fixed €4 participation payment for the online questionnaire and laboratory study. The recipient makes no counterdecision. The first two recipients are a Bonn university student and a student at another German university; the other two are the local and nonlocal members of the assigned recipient group. The other city is not named to participants. The user supplies the complete set of four recipients and identifies the one answer to predict. The other amounts on the current page are not supplied as history. All earlier questionnaire responses supplied below were collected at least 12 hours before the laboratory session. They are this person’s self-reports, not group statistics or other recipients’ decisions. Output only the integer number of euro cents given to the specified recipient, from 0 to 200 inclusive, without currency symbols, explanation or the amount retained.
